theme: Reach normal form in fewest rewrites
title: Confluent Collapse: Minimum-Step Term Rewriting
strategies: leftmost-outermost: always contract the shallowest live redex (root-first); duplicates un-reduced drop-work every time a dup fires early, and the duplication compounds across nested dups

drop-first-then-outermost-dup: eagerly collapse every reachable drop before touching any dup, but still fire dups shallowest-first once drops are gone -- fixes the drop/dup ordering mistake but repeats the same mistake among nested dups

leftmost-innermost / shrink-before-duplicate: never fire a redex whose argument still contains a redex, so every dup only ever copies already-fully-reduced material -- exploits confluence's order-freedom to reach the true step-count minimum
invalid: declares victory after a few arbitrary steps without ever reaching a redex-free normal form
